thesis: The speaker argues that the recorded music business declined due to piracy and falling CD sales until digital streaming caused revenue to level off and ascend again. He states that major record labels focus resources on new artists rather than iconic legends, which led him to found Primary Wave in 2006 to provide a dedicated service for marketing and promoting the rights of those legendary artists.
